decisions.reason: Substantial sunk investments and a public renaming of an already well-received model create strong escalation pressure to persist.
The multi-model high-speed grinder line has absorbed considerable engineering and launch costs, and public commitment makes withdrawal unlikely despite limited visibility.
Niche positioning with sunk engineering costs and managerial responsibility for the fine shredder sustain escalation-driven persistence.
The green-waste grinder line is central to the announced resource-saving direction, so early weak results are still attributed to temporary causes and justify continued commitment.
Its own product page and several models represent major public commitment, so escalation strongly favors keeping the pre-shredder line.
